lemma fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus' {f : Y → V}
    (μ : Measure Y) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] [μ.IsOpenPosMeasure]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace Y]
    (hf : Continuous f) (hg : ∀ g, IsTestFunction g → ∫ x, ⟪f x, g x⟫_ℝ ∂μ = 0) :
    f = 0 := by
  rw [funext_iff]; by_contra h₀
  obtain ⟨x₀, hx0⟩ := not_forall.1 h₀
  simp at hx0
  have hpos : 0 < ⟪f x₀, f x₀⟫_ℝ :=
    lt_of_le_of_ne real_inner_self_nonneg' (Ne.symm (mt inner_self_eq_zero'.mp hx0))
  have hinner_cont : Continuous (fun x => ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ) :=
    Continuous.inner' f (fun _ => f x₀) hf continuous_const
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ_pos, inner_pos_V⟩ :=
    Metric.isOpen_iff.mp (isOpen_lt continuous_const hinner_cont) x₀ hpos
  haveI : HasContDiffBump Y := hasContDiffBump_of_innerProductSpace Y
  let φ : ContDiffBump x₀ := ⟨δ / 2, δ, half_pos hδ_pos, half_lt_self hδ_pos⟩
  have hg_test : IsTestFunction (fun x => φ x • f x₀) :=
    IsTestFunction.smul_right ⟨φ.contDiff, φ.hasCompactSupport⟩ contDiff_const
  have key_integral := hg (fun x => φ x • f x₀) hg_test
  simp only [inner_smul_right'] at key_integral
  have h_nonneg : 0 ≤ fun x => φ x * ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ := by
    intro x
    by_cases hx : x ∈ Function.support φ
    · exact mul_nonneg φ.nonneg (inner_pos_V (φ.support_eq.subset hx)).le
    · simp [Function.notMem_support.mp hx]
  have integral_pos : 0 < ∫ x, φ x * ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ ∂μ :=
    Continuous.integral_pos_of_hasCompactSupport_nonneg_nonzero
      ((ContDiffBump.continuous φ).mul hinner_cont)
      (φ.hasCompactSupport.mono fun _ h => (mul_ne_zero_iff.mp h).1)
      h_nonneg
      (ne_of_gt (mul_pos (φ.pos_of_mem_ball (Metric.mem_ball_self hδ_pos)) hpos))
  exact integral_pos.ne' key_integral
